title: Privacy-safe and GDPR-conscious recruiting
summary: Recruiting runs on personal data, so privacy cannot be an afterthought. Record a lawful basis before contact, minimise what you collect, encrypt it at rest, and make erasure a single action to keep candidate trust and compliance intact.

faq.q: What is a lawful basis for contacting a candidate?
faq.a: A lawful basis is the legal ground (such as consent or legitimate interest) you record before processing a candidate's data. Capture it at first contact and check it before sending any message.

faq.q: How long should candidate data be retained?
faq.a: Keep candidate data only as long as you have a clear purpose, set a workspace-wide retention period, and delete or anonymise records once it passes.
